|-|English=

Graceful, polite, and disciplined, that's the first impression that Freesia leaves on most.

However, this illusion quickly shatters when they see her playing rock-paper-scissors with kids in all seriousness well past their bedtime.

"It is an honor to be your companion. I have much to learn from you."

|-|Japanese=

巡遊者ギルド『ヨロズ配達』の配達員。

言葉遣いや仕草の端々に、上品な雰囲気をのぞかせるが、実は決闘好きで、

血気盛んな一面を併せ持つ。

「いいお天気、絶好の決闘日和ですわね」

|-|Korean=

여행가 겸 요로즈 택배의 배달원.

말투나 몸짓 곳곳에서 품위 있는 분위기를 풍긴다.

우수하고 의지할 수 있는 존재이지만, 혈기왕성한 일면도 보유하고 있다.

"좋은 날씨네요. 결투하기 딱 좋은 날씨에요."

|-|Chinese=

万送屋的信使。

“举止优雅、礼貌克制。”——这是常人对苍兰的第一印象。

但看到她和小朋友一本正经地猜拳到深夜时……一些大小姐形象便悄然粉碎了。

「猜拳，也是决斗的一种。」

habilidades.b: Swings the greataxe to attack enemies. If Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, she rapidly hacks at enemies instead.

tpl.s: Swings the great axe to attack the target. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. In ⟨Berserk⟩ state, rapidly hacks at enemies instead. Strike 1: ⟦5⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦6⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦7⟧, ⟦8⟧, and ⟦9⟧ as Aqua Auto ATK DMG.

habilidades.b: Charges up and continuously deals DMG to nearby targets. The Main Skill can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ and inflict ⟨Chill⟩.

tpl.s: Charges up to unleash a Whirlwind Slash, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG to nearby targets every 0.3s. Charging increases the skill's duration and keeps striking the target for up to 3.6s. Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Aqua Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Chill⟩.

habilidades.b: Generates Ice Flowers to deal DMG. The Support Skill can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

tpl.s: Creates a field of Ice Flowers ahead, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. After 1s, the Ice Flowers burst, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Frost Bloom (Support Skill) can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

habilidades.b: Deals damage to nearby targets and enters ⟨Berserk⟩.

tpl.s: Freesia growls furiously, dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Ultimate DMG in a large area. She then deals ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Ultimate DMG and enters the ⟨Berserk⟩ status for 20s. When Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩ status as a support Trekker, she will automatically attack nearby enemies.

builds.d: A DPS build that combines multiple spinning slashes with Auto Attacks.
A build that deals DMG through continuous spinning slashes.

l.b: When the Main Skill ends, leaves a cloud of icy mist, reducing the Movement SPD of enemies caught inside the area and increasing the Auto Attack DMG of all friendly units in the same area.
l.s: When Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) ends, leaves a cloud of icy mist, lasting for 10s. For enemies caught inside the mist, reduces their Movement SPD by ⟦0⟧; for all friendly units within the same area, increases their Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Main Skill cannot be charged. When it ends, deals additional DMG.
l.s: Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) cannot be charged.  When it ends, deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. For each target hit, reduces Skill Cooldown by ⟦1⟧s, up to a total of ⟦2⟧s.

l.b: Casting this Main Skill increases the damage of the next Ultimate. Also increases Auto Attack DMG when Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩.
l.s: Casting Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) increases the DMG of the next Ultimate's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, increases her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: When the Main Skill ends, increases Freesia's ATK.
l.s: When Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) ends, increases Freesia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 9s.

l.b: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting the Main Skill increases her ATK.
l.s: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 7s.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG and the number of attacks.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧. The skill will launch ⟦1⟧ additional attacks. For every ⟦2⟧s charge time, it launches ⟦3⟧ more attacks.

l.b: While casting the Main Skill, Freesia is immune to control, and her Attack Range and Skill DMG are increased.
l.s: While casting Freezing Swirl (Main Skill), Freesia is ⟦0⟧, and her Attack Range is increased by ⟦1⟧.  When she deals damage, increases Skill DMG by ⟦2⟧, up to 24 stacks.

l.b: While casting the Main Skill, ice axes will fall and deal DMG every few seconds.
l.s: While casting Freezing Swirl (Main Skill), falling ice axes deal ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG every 1.5s.

l.b: The Main Skill has a chance to trigger ⟨Shatter⟩ or increase the DMG dealt.
l.s: When Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) deals DMG to a normal target with ⟨Freeze⟩, there is a 50% chance to trigger ⟨Shatter⟩. When dealing DMG to an elite or boss target with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩, there is a 50% chance to increase the DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting this Main Skill won't reduce the duration of Berserk and its DMG will be increased gradually.
l.s: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting Freezing Swirl (Main Skill) won't reduce the duration of Berserk, and its Skill DMG will be increased by ⟦0⟧ per second.

l.b: When Freesia triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, if she is in ⟨Berserk⟩, extends the duration of her Berserk.
l.s: When Freesia triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, if she is in ⟨Berserk⟩, extends the duration of her Berserk by ⟦0⟧s. This effect can only be triggered ⟦1⟧ times.

l.b: Freesia can dodge one more time. When Freesia triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, she gains Energy.
l.s: Freesia can dodge one more time. When Freesia triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, she gains ⟦0⟧ Energy. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩ and inflict ⟨Chill⟩. Triggering this effect will increases Freesia's ATK.
l.s: Elegy of Frost (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, dealing 52%/67%/82%/98%/113%/129% of ATK as AoE Aqua Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Chill⟩. Also increases Freesia's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 8s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG. While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, every time the Ultimate hits a target, increases Freesia's Crit DMG.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Elegy of Frost (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧. While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, every time the Ultimate hits a target, increases Freesia's Crit DMG by ⟦1⟧, stacking up to 20 times.

l.b: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting any skill increases her Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: While Freesia is in ⟨Berserk⟩, casting any skill increases her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: When Freesia enters the ⟨Berserk⟩ status, she inflicts ⟨Freeze⟩ on nearby targets. After casting the Ultimate, Freesia's Auto Attacks have a chance to trigger ⟨Shatter⟩ or increase DMG.
l.s: When Freesia enters the ⟨Berserk⟩ status, she inflicts ⟨Freeze⟩ on nearby targets for 3s. Within 10s after casting the Ultimate, Auto Attack DMG dealt on an elite or boss target with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ have a 50% chance to increase by ⟦0⟧. Auto Attack DMG dealt on a normal target with ⟨Freeze⟩ have a 50% chance to trigger ⟨Shatter⟩.
